_comment: Freshness ledger for the question banks. Each entry pins a cert bank (src/data/<cert>/domainN.json) to { contentHash, lastmod }, where lastmod is the date that bank content last changed. The production build READS lastmod (sitemap <lastmod>, Course.dateModified, the visible "Last updated" stamp) and NEVER mutates this file, so freshness reflects real content change, not deploy time. Maintainer workflow: after editing a bank run `npm run bank:lastmod` and commit this file. `npm run validate` warns and the unit suite fails if it drifts.
